messages:
Maya: Hey team — quick proposal for a tiny deploy-coordinator command set to speed up change-window + pin/rollback ops. Outline below.
Kevin: Love it. quick list?
Maya: Goals: single compact flow for the release lead: start deploy, annotate release note, pin version (ephemeral option), schedule change-window, add rollback rationale. Minimal UX: 3-5 commands.
Sam: Example commands: 
Maya: ```
/dc start --service web --version v2.13.0 --notes "tweak caching on hot paths"
/dc pin --id 12345 --ephemeral --expires 30m
/dc schedule --window 2026-04-01T18:00Z --slo low-latency
/dc rollback --from 12345 --reason "regression in batcheners" --auto-dryrun
```
Jun: Ephemeral pin is strong — auto-unpin after window ends or on rollback. Cuts down manual cleanup.
Kevin: Also add `/dc checklist` to generate preflight tasks + a link to a prefilled GH release draft. Bot should post a checklist message in the channel.
Maya: Bot responses should be compact and actionable. Example: `deploy-coordinator: started deploy 12345 for web v2.13.0 — window 2026-04-01T18:00Z — ephemeral pin until +30m` with buttons for `Abort`, `Rollback (dryrun)`, `Open release draft`.
Sam: Need a `--canary` flag for staged pins: `--canary=10%` then `--promote` to global. Bot should show current canary percentage.
ops-bot: deploy 12345: canary rollout started (10% traffic) — monitor: latency, error-rate
Arjun: Abort behavior: `/dc abort --id 12345 --mode rollback|pause` and `/dc resume`. Abort should attach the rollback rationale to the release notes.
Maya: Release note template bot fills: feature bullets, impact, migration notes, quick rollback snippet. Example snippet returned by bot: `- Feature: cache parity fix
- DB: no migrations
- Quick rollback: /dc rollback --from 12345 --reason "hotfix"`
Kevin: UX: bot creates a pinned runbook in the channel with checkboxes for preflight items (smoke tests, infra checks, metrics baseline). Team members can check off.
Sam: Ops want a small cost/latency estimate per window — bot can surface cost delta and warn if we exceed typical qps.
Maya: Security: RBAC enforced: only release-owners group can `pin`/`rollback`/`abort`. Audit log entries for every command.
Jun: Implementation plan: prototype a few REST endpoints in releasebot service and a thin slash command shim. Minimal state in bot: deploy id, pin meta, window, canary %.
Maya: Backwards compat: bot should accept legacy `/deploy` flags and translate to `/dc` flows for older scripts.
Kevin: Volunteers: I can do the prototype API. Sam will own the bot UX messages. Maya will draft release note templates and runbook checklists.
Maya: I'll spin up a short design doc and a tiny demo Monday. Sync tomorrow 10:00am PT? :thumbsup:
